privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.p1: RemesaSmart SV is a household financial management application. The team maintaining this application is responsible for processing the data.
privacy.pendingContact: To be completed by the team before publication: the responsible party's full name and contact channel.
privacy.p2: The application stores only the data you provide:
privacy.accountData: name, email address, password, and household name.
privacy.financialData: transactions (amount, date, type, description, and source), categories, budgets, savings goals, goal contributions, and financial education notes you record.
privacy.technicalData: a session token and basic user information stored in your browser's local storage.
privacy.p3: We do not request card, bank account, identity document, or location data. The application does not process payments or make transfers.
privacy.passwordProtection: Your password is not stored in plain text: it is stored as a hash using an industry-standard algorithm and cannot be recovered from the database.
privacy.sessionProtection: Access to protected sections requires a signed session token that expires automatically.
privacy.householdProtection: Each household can only view its own data: queries are filtered by the authenticated user's household.
privacy.p4: Only to provide the service: calculate the dashboard summary, show your transactions and budgets, generate budget alerts, and keep your session active. We do not use data for advertising, sell it, or share it with third parties.
privacy.p5: In the PostgreSQL database on the server where the application is deployed. Data is not copied to external services or third-party analytics tools.
privacy.p6: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your data at any time. You can sign out of the application and clear local storage in your browser settings. To exercise these rights, contact the responsible team through the channel listed on this page.
privacy.p7: If we change how we handle data, we will update this page and show the date of the latest change at the beginning of the document.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.p1: By creating an account or using RemesaSmart SV, you accept these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the application.
terms.s2: 2. What this application is and is not
terms.p2: RemesaSmart SV is a household financial organization tool: it lets you record transactions, set budgets, save goals, and view summaries.
terms.notFinancialService: It is not a financial service.
terms.p3: It does not process payments, transfer money, manage bank accounts, or provide financial, tax, or investment advice. Its calculations are informational and are based solely on the data you record.
terms.account1: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential.
terms.account2: You must provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
terms.account3: Your account is personal: sharing it may expose your household's financial information.
terms.prohibited1: Attempt to access another household's data.
terms.prohibited2: Interfere with the operation of the application.
terms.prohibited3: Use it for unlawful purposes or to impersonate others.
terms.prohibited4: Bypass security measures or automate abuse.
terms.p5: The application is provided as is. Interruptions may occur due to maintenance, errors, or causes beyond our control. We work to keep it stable but do not guarantee continuous availability or complete absence of errors.
terms.p6: You are responsible for financial decisions based on the information recorded. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the responsible team is not liable for damages arising from using or being unable to use the application.
terms.p7: You may stop using the application at any time and request deletion of your account and household data. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms.
terms.p8: These terms may be updated; the date of the latest change appears at the beginning of the document.
terms.pendingContact: To be completed by the team: contact channel for the responsible party.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.p1: RemesaSmart SV does not use first-party or third-party cookies. There are no advertising, analytics, or social media cookies, so the application does not show a consent banner: there is nothing to consent to.
cookies.p2: Instead of cookies, the application uses browser local storage (localStorage), information that stays on your device and that this application can read from the same origin:
cookies.token: the session token, which expires after 8 hours.
cookies.user: basic account data so you do not have to sign in on every visit.
cookies.p3: When you sign out, the application removes both entries.
cookies.p4: We do not include Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, heat maps, or social widgets. The only requests made by the application go to its own server.
cookies.p5: You can clear local storage at any time in your browser's privacy settings or by signing out of the application. You will then be asked to sign in again.
cookies.p6: If we add cookies in the future, we will update this page and request consent before installing them. The date of the latest change appears at the beginning of the document.
